name: flashcard
title: Flashcard
description: A front/back flashcard (RF-1) with a 3D flip interaction, built on @didact/ui's Card/Button/ToggleGroup: a single primary 'Reveal answer' Button discloses the back face, and only then does a segmented ToggleGroup rating control (Known / Needs review) appear in the CardFooter -- reveal-then-rate, with one action hierarchy tier per docs/interface-norms.md. Both flip and rating are controllable or left to the component's own state. Presentation only -- no scheduling or persistence, see packages/core/src/components/flashcard.tsx for the full rationale.
